rawText: DEMO FIXTURE — GePNIC UP Public Notice. Supply and Installation of IP CCTV Surveillance Cameras in Lucknow Collectorate. The bidder must possess average annual turnover of at least Rs. 20 lakh during the last three financial years. Bidder must have minimum 2 years experience in supply and installation of CCTV surveillance equipment. The contractor shall have a functional service center in Uttar Pradesh. Submit valid GST Registration and PAN certificate. EMD is Rs. 70,000 with MSE exemptions as per UP Procurement Rules. Bids close on 25 November 2026 at 15:30 IST.
